# laravel_cloud_database_restore (Resource)

Restores a Laravel Cloud database cluster from a snapshot or point-in-time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravel_cloud_database_cluster" "example" {
  name   = "my-db"
  type   = "laravel_mysql_84"
  region = "us-east-2"

  # `config` is an opaque JSON document whose shape depends on the database
  # type. Every key the API returns must be present, with exactly the value it
  # stores, or the next plan shows a permanent diff. Discover the schema and
  # the valid `size` enum with `GET /databases/types`.
  config = jsonencode({
    size                     = "mysql-flex-512mb"
    storage                  = 10
    is_public                = false
    uses_scheduled_snapshots = false
    retention_days           = 7
    suspend_seconds          = 0
  })
}

resource "laravel_cloud_database_snapshot" "example" {
  cluster_id = laravel_cloud_database_cluster.example.id
  name       = "nightly"
}

resource "laravel_cloud_database_restore" "example" {
  database_cluster_id  = laravel_cloud_database_cluster.example.id
  name                 = "restored-db"
  database_snapshot_id = laravel_cloud_database_snapshot.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_cluster_id` (String) Source database cluster ID to restore from.
- `name` (String) Name for the restored database cluster.

### Optional

- `database_snapshot_id` (String) Snapshot ID to restore from. Mutually exclusive with restore_time.
- `restore_time` (String) Point-in-time to restore to (ISO 8601). Mutually exclusive with database_snapshot_id.

### Read-Only

- `config` (String) JSON-encoded configuration of the restored cluster.
- `connection_details` (Attributes) Read-only connection details for the restored cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_details))
- `id` (String) ID of the restored database cluster.
- `region` (String) Region of the restored cluster.
- `restored_cluster_name` (String) Name of the restored cluster.
- `restored_cluster_status` (String) Status of the restored cluster.
- `restored_cluster_type` (String) Type of the restored cluster.

### Nested Schema for `connection_details`

Read-Only:

- `driver` (String)
- `hostname` (String)
